summary: Archive button moves mail into yearly folders despite single folder setting
description:
User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_3) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/80.0.3987.132 Safari/537.36

Steps to reproduce:

- Via Account Settings / Folders / Archive Options, I selected that all messages shall be archived in one single folder.

- Clicked the "Archive" button in the message window of a message in my Inbox.

Actual results:

The message got moved into a "2020" subfolder of my selected Archive folder.

Expected results:

The message should have been moved into the Archive folder at top level due to my single folder setting.
